content:
The image shows a mango leaf with a white, powdery coating concentrated in patches on the upper surface. The lesions are irregular, whitish-gray, and have a dusty/mealy texture typical of fungal mycelium. The leaf itself appears otherwise green and intact with no necrosis or dieback.

This matches Powdery Mildew: white powdery fungal growth on leaf surface, not brown necrotic spots (Anthracnose), not wilting/dead shoot tips (Die Back), and not the sooty black coating of Sooty Mould.
